items.title: 哑光木框与纸页 · 修订
items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign ONLY the functional UI in this existing game screenshot according to the art direction below. Keep original saloon pixel background, Hank character, pose, teal table runner, composition and original UI footprints. No red annotation or editor UI. Top title/status bar, left navigation, right guest notes, bottom dialogue and buttons all become matching understated pixel UI. Top bar muted walnut with small cream paper status insets, natural flat pixel coin/star/calendar/clock icons. Left compact wood tiles with 酒馆 图鉴 商店 研发 酒单 手帐 调酒模式, 酒馆 selected sage teal. Right guest note almost plain cream paper with dark text 老霍克. Bottom dialogue pale paper dark text and small pixel portrait; action button subdued warm brown with ivory text 前往调酒台, secondary button plain cream with dark text 送客，迎接下一位. Title 致未归的客人 flat ivory. Keep labels readable and retain hierarchy, don't enlarge frames or cover the guest. Full landscape 16:9 gameplay mockup. Art direction OVERRIDE: quiet hand-drawn low-gloss PIXEL GAME UI, matte unvarnished walnut + plain warm cream paper + desaturated sage-teal. Use mostly flat color clusters with just 2 restrained tone steps per material, crisp 2px stepped corners and modest 1px cast shadow, fully pixel-grid-aligned. Remove EVERY gold corner ornament, metal bracket, bolt, rivet, sparkling highlight, white bevel, inner glow, embossed gold text and ornamental flourish. No shiny golden continuous outlines. No directional gradient or drop-shadow glow. Frames are slim muted dark-brown outlines with a sparse short lighter wood mark, not thick three-dimensional furniture. Paper is nearly uniform warm cream, no dirty parchment speckles or torn borders. Wood grain nearly absent except a few dark short pixel strokes far from text. Text flat dark brown on paper or muted ivory on dark wood, no outline/bevel. Icons are compact flat pixel glyphs with natural muted colors, NOT miniature glossy gold objects. Large readable Chinese glyphs, no tiny texture noise. Selected state is a plain muted sage-teal fill; hover only a small color-value change, pressed only 1-2 pixel offset. No neon, no fantasy RPG gold frames. Preserve clear visible pixel character and thoughtful handcrafted feel, not generic vector rectangles.
